claim_text: Their sustained improvement in FY25 indicates stronger hazard awareness and a more proactive reporting culture.
metric_name: Total significant hazard frequency; Significant hazard to significant event near miss ratio
context_text: Health and safety performance FY25/FY24: Total significant hazard frequency 196 / 122; Significant hazard to significant event near miss ratio 78 / 21.；Our significant hazard to significant event near miss ratio for FY25 was 80.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 指标改善能够支持公司在隐患识别和近失管理方面有所进展，但“stronger hazard awareness”与“more proactive reporting culture”属于文化层面的解释性判断，缺少直接验证数据。
notes: 文化与意识层面表述一般较难被单一指标充分支撑。
